title: What Are My Kidneys?
author: Lexi Kayser
mlbSummary: A child-friendly introduction to kidneys and chronic kidney disease that helps young readers understand what kidneys do, what can happen when they are not working well, and why medical care may be needed.
notes: Recommended by Children's Mercy for preschool to school-age children. Direct Amazon Kindle ASIN verified. No religious theme identified.

title: How Billy (the Kidney) Earned His Name: A Kidney Transplant Book for Kids
author: Stephanie Peters and Kendra Read
audience: School-age Children Facing Kidney Transplant & Families
mlbSummary: A humorous kidney-centered story created for elementary-age children and older who are experiencing kidney failure and transplant. The book introduces the transplant process and medical procedures in a way intended to make an unfamiliar experience easier to understand.
notes: ISBN, publication details, and kidney-transplant focus verified. Direct Amazon product uses ISBN-10/ASIN. No religious theme identified.

title: Tillie Explains: Having a Kidney Transplant
author: Fiona Cain
mlbSummary: Tillie the dog guides children through the kidney-transplant journey, explaining what kidneys do, why dialysis may be needed, what happens in the hospital, how surgery works, what recovery can look like, and why medicines remain important afterward.
notes: Published by Amazon Digital Services/KDP. ISBN and topic coverage verified. Created especially for families affected by Branchio-Oto-Renal Syndrome. No religious theme identified.
